articles.title: El efusivo canto de la Marcha de San Lorenzo que hizo Javier Milei junto a un granadero
articles.summary: President Milei participated in the Independence Day Tedeum at the Metropolitan Cathedral and sang the San Lorenzo March with members of the presidential cabinet and provincial authorities.

articles.title: Desde Tucumán, Milei llamó a los gobernadores a "sentar las bases para el futuro de una verdadera libertad"
articles.summary: President Milei conducted an analysis of his administration at the Independence Day vigil in Tucumán, highlighting the Pact of May and identifying three legislative priorities including elimination of primary elections and Central Bank reform.

articles.title: Ahora juega la casta: Javier Milei movió primero y fuerte para 2027
articles.summary: The Milei government launched a comprehensive campaign strategy for 2027 reelection, including electoral organizing, political reforms to eliminate primary elections, and negotiations with provincial governors.

articles.title: Javier Milei puso la Casa Rosada a disposición de la Selección y prometió no estar presente
articles.summary: President Milei offered the Casa Rosada for a potential national football team World Cup celebration while stating he would vacate the building to avoid political interference in the team's achievements.

articles.title: Giro a la derecha en América Latina: Javier Milei viajará a las asunciones de Keiko Fujimori en Perú y Abelardo de la Espriella en Colombia
articles.summary: President Milei will travel to Peru on July 28 and Colombia on August 7 to attend the inaugurations of right-wing leaders Keiko Fujimori and Abelardo de la Espriella, aligned with his ideology.
